name: Lugard Gbenga Agbomoagan
role: International Lawyer. Hospitality Executive. Entrepreneur. Cross-Border Legal Practice Advocate. ~Philanthropist
bio: Lugard Gbenga Agbomoagan is a Nigerian legal practitioner, entrepreneur, hospitality executive, international legal policy advocate and philanthropist. He is Founder and Managing Partner of G. L. Agbomoagan Legal Practitioners & Consultants, Group Managing Director of The Jagz Hotel, and an Officer of the International Bar Association serving as Project Officer of the African Regional Forum. His work spans legal innovation, business leadership, education, philanthropy and cross-border legal practice across Africa.

name: Grace Uzoamaka Akalumhe
bio: Grace Uzoamaka Akalumhe is a Nigerian legal practitioner and Head of Practice at G. L. Agbomoagan Legal Practitioners & Solicitors, where she provides legal advisory, dispute-resolution and transactional support to individuals, businesses and not-for-profit organisations. She is particularly interested in cross-border legal collaboration, institutional partnerships, capacity building and initiatives that improve access to legal services across jurisdictions. She seeks to contribute her practical experience, leadership skills and understanding of Nigeria’s legal and regulatory environment to the Association’s not-for-profit objectives.
qualifications: She holds an LL.B from the University of Lagos, a B.L from the Nigerian Law School and a B.Sc. in Business Administration from Olabisi Onabanjo University. She is currently pursuing an LL.M at the University of Lagos, with academic and professional interests in international law, constitutional law, maritime law and jurisprudence.
experience: Her experience spans commercial and general litigation, corporate law, property and tenancy matters, employment advisory, probate administration, regulatory compliance and human-rights advocacy. She advises clients on corporate formation and governance, including the incorporation and regulatory compliance of companies, business names and incorporated trustees. She also represents clients before courts, law-enforcement agencies and regulatory institutions. Grace combines her legal qualifications with an academic background in Business Administration and extensive experience in law-office management, human resources, financial administration and organisational compliance. Her exposure to gender equality and human-rights matters through the Office of the Public Defender further reflects her commitment to access to justice and socially responsive legal practice.
awards: Grace is a member of the Nigerian Bar Association and the International Bar Association. She has also undertaken professional training in arbitration and legal writing.

name: Onome Cynthia Anakanire
role: Legal Counsel & Director, New York State Senate Committee on Banks
bio: Onome Cynthia Anakanire is an internationally qualified lawyer, privacy and AI governance professional, and public policy adviser whose career spans private practice, multinational organisations, international institutions, and government across Africa, Europe, and the United States. She currently serves as Legal Counsel and Director of the New York State Senate Committee on Banks, advising on banking legislation, financial regulation, consumer protection, and emerging legal and policy issues affecting financial services.
qualifications: Her international experience includes privacy, compliance and governance roles with Allianz Direct, AXA XL, AXA Mansard, and the Organisation for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons (OPCW), including work on data protection, regulatory compliance, governance and cross-border legal issues.
experience: A member of both the Nigerian Bar and the New York Bar, she holds advanced law degrees from institutions in Nigeria, France, Belgium and the United States, a Master of Science in Project Management, and internationally recognised certifications including FIP, CIPP/E, CIPP/US and CIPM. Her work sits at the intersection of law, technology, financial regulation and public policy, with a focus on responsible innovation, cross-border commerce, data protection and artificial intelligence governance.

name: Rikayat Ojo-Oba
role: CISM, CIPM, CISA, CRISC, Fellow Privacy Technology | CISO, SoEmailSecurity
bio: Rukky Ojo-Oba is a multidisciplinary legal and information security professional, combining a background in Law with extensive experience across industries. She has worked in aviation, sports, consulting, education, entertainment and Telecommunications industries in different capacities. Her work involves developing and implementing security strategies, strengthening organizational resilience, managing information security risks, and ensuring alignment with applicable regulatory and industry standards. Currently serving as Chief Information Security Officer at SoEmailSecurity, she provides strategic leadership in information security, cybersecurity governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, and data privacy. With a strong legal foundation and a technology-focused professional portfolio, she brings a distinctive perspective to the intersection of law, technology, cybersecurity, privacy, and business risk. She serves on boards of both private and non-governmental organizations with particular interest in empowering women and young people to shape the future of cybersecurity and digital safety.

name: Rita Yetunde Ogayemi
bio: She is a highly accomplished financial professional with over 15 years of expertise in accounting, auditing, tax consulting, and financial management. Her impressive track record of delivering strategic financial solutions has earned her a reputation as a trusted advisor to businesses and individuals. As a seasoned financial expert, Rita Ogayemi brings a unique blend of technical expertise, business acumen, and exceptional client service skills to help clients achieve their financial goals. Her expertise has been sought by various organizations, and she continues to be a valuable resource in the financial industry. Outside of her professional pursuits, Rita Ogayemi enjoys exploring creative cookery and staying engaged with detective series.
